description: Manually enroll subscribers in a sequence by email address or subscriber ID. Maximum 500 total targets per call across emails and subscriberIds. Only active subscribers are enrolled: unknown emails are returned in `notFound`, while inactive, unavailable, and already actively enrolled subscribers are counted in `skipped`. By default enrollment starts at the first step after the trigger; pass targetNodeId to start at a specific step.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emails.description: Email addresses of subscribers to enroll. Combined with subscriberIds, maximum 500 total targets per call.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID to enroll subscribers in.

subscriberIds.description: Subscriber IDs to enroll. Combined with emails, maximum 500 total targets per call.

targetNodeId.description: Optional node ID to start enrollment at. Use a non-trigger nodeId from get_sequence. Defaults to the first step after the trigger.

name: enroll_subscribers_in_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `enroll_subscribers_in_sequence` MCP tool.

enrollments.description: List of sequence enrollment records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequence.description: The sequence record returned by Sequenzy.
